address_forms_and_conditions.policy: Use name or role where natural; avoid unsupported kinship and gender. Do not infer age or gender from a Japanese name. Respect requested form of address exactly when that is the learning target.

names_honorifics_and_unknown_gender_age: Retain Japanese name glyphs when pronunciation is not supplied. Preserve さん in explicit address-learning targets; do not invent a Khmer phonetic reading or gendered title.
register_and_social_phrases: Warm respectful adult Khmer; complete connected explanations; សូម for requests and permissions as appropriate; preserve social function in context without adding promises.
